notes.title: Playtest v0.5.1 and Demo preparation!
notes.content: We made bug fixes and minor changes in this release. There will be no big playtest update after this. At most, small hotfixes like this may come. Now we will put all our effort into the demo.

notes.title: Playtest v0.5 is Live!
notes.content:
Our new playtest version is live!

-Improvements have been made according to feedback.
-Detected bugs have been fixed.
-Changes, enhancements and improvements have been made to the combat system.
-Improvements and improvements have been made to the map system.
-Character related bug fixes, improvements and enhancements.
-Market related changes, fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Playtest v0.4 is Live!
notes.content: A brand new version for Playtest is waiting for you. We would be very happy if you give it a chance and share your ideas with us.

notes.title: Playtest v0.3
notes.content: Playtest has been completely revamped. We would be very happy if you give the game a chance again and give us feedback.

notes.title: Playtest v0.2
notes.content: Playtest version has been renewed. We would be very happy if you give the game a chance again and give us your feedback.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.03
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with the game ending, now our endless runs have an ending.

Other identified bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.02
notes.content:
Fixed the inability to shop at the blacksmith.
Adjusted the damage and purchase amount of weapons.
Increased barrel damage.
Overhauled buggy traps and zones.
Changed the merchant skin.
Fixed the inability to adjust the weapon sound volume.
Removed the tutorial from the menu and integrated it into the village.

Fixed various reported in-game bugs.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Fixed the inability to shop in the store.
Added outliner to make merchants more visible.
Fixed the issue with music not changing level.
Fixed detected translation errors.
Fixed various in-game bugs that were detected.

Known Bugs :
Tutorial related bugs.
